modules.name: Login and Registration
modules.description: Covers how users log in, register, and have their access managed in the Customer Support App.

requirements.title: OTP login on mobile
requirements.description: A user with a registered number who enters the correct OTP logs in with their role.

requirements.title: Admin login on web
requirements.description: Admin staff logging in on the web must provide both password and OTP.

requirements.title: Self-registration on mobile
requirements.description: A new user can submit their details on mobile, and the request goes only to that project's Society Manager.

requirements.title: Pending request status screen
requirements.description: While a registration request is pending, the app shows only the status screen when opened.

requirements.title: Switch between flats or roles with one login
requirements.description: A user with several flats or roles uses a single login and can switch between flats, e.g. a user with 2 flats.

requirements.title: Instant access removal on deactivation
requirements.description: A deactivated user is logged out the next time they use the app, on both mobile and web.

rules.title: Block number after 5 wrong OTP attempts
rules.description: After 5 wrong OTP attempts, a further attempt causes the number to be blocked for 30 minutes.
